$comment: p15-oracle-064: the workspace family's 26 mutations (workspace, workspace_checklist, workspace_group, workspace_log, workspace_progress, workspace_status; gen_daemon_ops.py reads this file, run it after an edit). Untuned operations keep the generated request: their success reaches the handler on the standard fixture and their error is the catalog check's validation.invalid. The tuned ones reach a handler-level refusal (an unknown fixture object, a URL or app the handler refuses, Gate A2) and assert its typed details where the refusal has them (the checklist store's refusal has only a prose reason), or need a precondition the generated request lacks. Two successes no product runs yet carry a gap naming the task that closes it: workspace.agent_folder.set is user only (request_origin.rs USER_ONLY_OPERATIONS) while driver_daemon.py's connection derives origin agent (p15-oracle-237), and workspace.ensure_app needs an installed first-party app, of which the case daemon has none (p15-oracle-248). p15-oracle-209 tunes workspace.run so its case and the mcp suite's twin of it end in one state.
